notes.title: New release date announced for Chapter 2 of The Midnight Crimes.
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your patience and excitement for The Midnight Crimes. We've been working hard on Chapter 2 to ensure it lives up to the dark, immersive atmosphere of Midnight Cove.
To deliver the best experience possible, we’ve decided to delay the release. Although it was planned for this month, we need more time to refine every detail clues, dialogues, and scenes alike.
This means that all subsequent episodes will also be delayed in their release.
We truly appreciate your support. As a thank you, we’ll be sharing new previews and exclusive story content in the coming weeks. The mystery of Midnight Cove continues, and we can’t wait for you to see what’s next.
Chapter Two of The Midnight Crimes will be released on July, 2025

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
[b]Sincerely,
DeadlyCrow Games Team[/b]

notes.title: The Midnight Crimes launches TODAY
notes.notes:
The moment has arrived!
The Midnight Crimes launches TODAY, at 13:30 PST. Transport yourself to a steampunk dystopia where gears, engines, and cutting-edge technology bring this dark and murky world to life; the tension hangs in the air. Immerse yourself in this point-and-click adventure, packed with hidden dangers behind the smoke and rusted machinery, as you strive to solve the city’s most chilling crime: the disappearance of children and the illicit movement of suspicious substances...

Are you ready to unravel this mystery? Sharpen your senses, prepare your tools, load your gun, and light your cigarette, because the secrets lurking in the shadows will put your courage and morality to the test.

Merry Christmas, and welcome to our nightmare of steam and shadows!

notes.title: The Midnight Crimes Selected for Latin American Games Showcase!
notes.notes:
Dear gamers, we have thrilling news to share! Our game, The Midnight Crimes, [b]has been chosen for the OFFICIAL SELECTION 2024 of the prestigious @LAGShowcase[/b]. This is a significant achievement for our team, and we are thrilled to present our game to a global audience.

The Latin American Games Showcase (LAGS) highlights innovative games from Latin America, and being part of the official selection is a testament to our team's hard work and dedication in developing The Midnight Crimes.

[h3]What is The Midnight Crimes?[/h3]
If you like steampunk and point and click games, The Midnight Crimes is for you. A captivating adventure set in a dark and mysterious world. Players become detectives solving crimes under the cover of night, offering a unique blend of puzzle-solving, exploration, and narrative-driven gameplay.

[h3]Mark Your Calendars![/h3]
Join us on June 8th at 10 AM PT/UTC -7 for the Latin American Games Showcase to see exclusive footage of The Midnight Crimes. The showcase will be live-streamed on Twitch, YouTube, and Steam, giving you a sneak peek into the immersive world we've created.

Follow us on social media for updates and behind-the-scenes content leading up to the event. Use #LAGS2024 to join the conversation and connect with fellow gamers.

We are grateful for the support of our community and the organizers of the Latin American Games Showcase. Your enthusiasm has been instrumental in bringing The Midnight Crimes to life, and we are honored to share it with gamers worldwide.

Get ready for an unforgettable experience on June 8th. Join us at the showcase and uncover the mysteries of The Midnight Crimes. Stay tuned for more updates and surprises as we approach the event.

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to share The Midnight Crimes with you. 

See you there!

[b]Showcase Date: June 8th, 10 AM PT/UTC -7[/b]

notes.title: Exciting News! We're Going to be Part of MIX Online Showcase
notes.notes:
This is an incredible opportunity for us to present our latest project, The Midnight Crimes, and share all the exciting details with you. For those who are not familiar with MIX (Media Indie Exchange), it is a platform that brings together independent game developers and gamers. It serves as a bridge between creators and enthusiasts, providing a space where innovative projects can shine.

Join us on Friday, March 15th at 10 am (PST) on the MIX and KindaFunny YouTube/Twitch channels. You won't want to miss this event as we unveil exclusive information about The Midnight Crimes.

The Midnight Crimes is an [b]immersive detective game that will transport players into a dark and mysterious world[/b]. Is a point-&-click detective adventure game, where you can play as Benjamin Leighton a retired private detective investigating the case of a missing child while facing his own past demons. Midnight Cove, the wicked Victorian city you live in, features semi-open world mechanics, side-quests, pets, character relationships and much more.

Inspired by classic film noir aesthetics and captivating storytelling, The Midnight Crimes promises an unforgettable gaming experience. Prepare yourself for suspenseful moments, challenging puzzles, and unexpected plot twists as you unravel the truth behind each crime.

[h2][h1][b]What Can You Expect from Our Showcase?[/b][/h1][/h2]

During the MIX online showcase on March 15th, we will provide an in-depth look into the gameplay mechanics, storylines, and unique features of The Midnight Crimes. Our team will walk you through some lore and development process. 

If you are a fan of detective games or enjoy immersive storytelling experiences, The Midnight Crimes is tailor-made for you. With its captivating atmosphere, engaging gameplay, and intriguing mysteries waiting to be unraveled, this game promises countless hours of entertainment. The attention to detail in The Midnight Crimes is remarkable. From the meticulously designed crime scenes to the complex character interactions, every element has been crafted with care to create an authentic detective experience like no other.

[b]Mark Your Calendars![/b]

Make sure to mark your calendars for Friday, March 15th at 10 am (PST) and join us on MIX and KindaFunny YouTube/Twitch channels for our online showcase. This is your chance to get an exclusive preview of The Midnight Crimes and be among the first to witness its potential.

Don't forget to spread the word! Share this exciting news with fellow gamers who appreciate immersive storytelling experiences.

Join us Friday, March 15th at 10 am (PST) on MIX and KindaFunny YouTube/Twitch channels! Hope to see you there! <3

notes.title: Announcement of Delay for DeadlyCrow Games' "The Midnight Crimes" Demo
notes.notes:
Dear "The Midnight Crimes" followers,

We want to inform you that we have made the decision to delay the release of DeadlyCrow Games' "The Midnight Crimes" demo until September 29th. This delay is necessary to ensure that all of you enjoy the best possible experience and to address some errors we have identified in the game.

We know you've been eagerly anticipating trying out the demo, and we deeply appreciate your patience and support. We believe that this extension will allow us to deliver a more polished and exciting product.

We appreciate your understanding and want to assure you that we are working diligently to make the wait worth your while. We are excited to share DeadlyCrow Games' "The Midnight Crimes" with all of you on September 29th and hope you enjoy the experience we have been crafting.

Thank you for being a part of this exciting journey with us!

Sincerely,
DeadlyCrow Games development team

notes.title: The Midnight Crimes
notes.notes:
We invite you to embark on an adventure in the late 19th century in a dystopian steampunk world full of mystery and surprises, where you will step into the shoes of Benjamin Leighton, a retired private detective involved in an spiral of bretayals, murder and tragedies that you will have to sort out to stay alive and solve the great mystery. Turn yourself into a detective in this demo of our latest point-and-click story game.
 
[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
🌟 Explore a stunning and grim steampunk city full of details and atmosphere.
🧩 Solve puzzles and mysteries that will test your wits.
🕵️ Embody Benjamin Leighton, an stoic retired detective with unique skills and a tragic past.
🤔 Make decisions that will influence the course of the investigation and the fate of the characters and your relationship with them.
🎶 Enjoy a captivating soundtrack that will immerse you in the experience.
 
[h2]Demo Release Date:[/h2]
Mark the date on your calendar. Our demo will be available for free download starting September 22, 2023.
 
[h2]Why You Should Play It:[/h2]
If you're a fan of immersive storytelling and mental challenges, this demo is perfect for you. Join Benjamin in his quest for the truth in a steampunk world full of intrigue, shadows and secrets. Every choice you make will impact the story's development.
